hibernate-mapping.sql-query: select s.*, count as responseCount from mr.surveys s, mr.responsecount r where s.id = r.id and s.account_id= :account_id

SELECT (vwtotals.pr_fn || ' ') || vwtotals.pr_ln AS prac_name, sum(vwtotals.num) AS count FROM vwtotals WHERE date_part('month', vwtotals.updated_at) = :month_selected AND date_part('year', vwtotals.updated_at) = :year_selected and department = :dept_selected GROUP BY (vwtotals.pr_fn || ' ') || vwtotals.pr_ln ORDER BY (vwtotals.pr_fn || ' ') || vwtotals.pr_ln

SELECT (vp.prac_first_name || ' ') || vp.prac_last_name AS prac_name, count(*) AS count FROM app_user u, vwprojects vp, mr.miroteams t WHERE u.miroteam_id = t.id and vp.id = u.project_id AND u.oldreport = false AND date_part('month', u.miroteamadded_on) = :month_selected AND date_part('year', u.miroteamadded_on) = :year_selected AND department = :dept_selected GROUP BY (vp.prac_first_name || ' ') || vp.prac_last_name ORDER BY (vp.prac_first_name || ' ') || vp.prac_last_name

SELECT u.id ,u.project_id,u.first_name,u.last_name,u.email,u.status, r.survey_id FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN mr.responses r ON u.response_id = r.id WHERE u.project_id = :project_id AND u.deleted = false ORDER BY u.id desc LIMIT :limit
